title: Security Deposits: Part-Year Interest Accrual to the Refund Date
content:
When a cash Security Deposits deposit is refunded part way through a calendar year, interest for that part of the year is accrued to the refund date. This policy posts the accrual for the part of the current calendar year that ends on the day a cash deposit is refunded.

## Rule

The refund-date accrual is worked out only after the deposit ledger carries a December 31 accrual for every earlier calendar year in which cash was held.

In other words, the part-year accrual of the refund year waits on the deposit ledger: each earlier calendar year in which the deposit held cash must already show its December 31 accrual there before the refund-date accrual has a figure.

- **Subject:** a cash deposit record being refunded today.
- **Result governed:** the interest amount of the refund-date accrual, with its accrual period, rate and days counted.
- **Business effect:** an interest accrual entry on the deposit ledger whose period ends on the refund date, and an increase of the interest accrued and not yet paid out on the deposit record.

## Booking function

`post_refund_date_deposit_interest_50449ec1` is an agent-side function: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**Capability.** It posts the interest accrual of the part of a year that ends on the day a cash security deposit is refunded. One call writes one interest accrual entry dated today on the deposit's ledger with the accrual period, the annual rate, the days counted and the interest amount, and adds that amount to the interest accrued and not yet paid out on the deposit record. The member sees the part-year interest on the deposit.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `deposit_account_id` | the reference number of the security deposit record, as returned by the deposit record lookup for the member | identifier text |
| `accrual_period_start` | the first day of the accrual period | a date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `accrual_period_end` | the last day of the accrual period | a date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `interest_rate_pct` | the annual interest rate applied, in percent | 2 decimal places; 1.84 means 1.84 percent |
| `accrual_days` | the number of days of the period on which interest is counted | an integer |
| `amount` | the interest accrued for the period, in USD | a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` ("accrued" on success), `deposit_entry_id` (reference number of the new ledger entry), `deposit_account_id`, `accrual_period_start` and `accrual_period_end` (YYYY-MM-DD), `interest_rate_pct` (percent, 2 decimal places), `accrual_days`, `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places) and `accrued_interest` (interest now accrued and unpaid on the record, USD, 2 decimal places).
